text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm Vodka! We're partners now, so let's
both do
our best!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win races and become the
coolest
runner of all! That's my ambition!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's someone out there I've just gotta
beat! So you can bet I'll be trying real
hard, and I'm
counting on you to do the
same!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
